summary.tldr: Delays until March 17, 2024, the repeal of the exclusion for medical assistance in dying when mental illness is the only underlying condition.
what_it_does: Delays the repeal of the exclusion from eligibility for medical assistance in dying when the sole underlying medical condition is a mental illness.
Keeps that exclusion in place until March 17, 2024.
who_it_affects: People seeking medical assistance in dying
summary.background: It amends An Act to amend the Criminal Code (medical assistance in dying).
